rationale: STX is trading at 98.5% of today's range after a sharp gap-down recovery, sitting just 0.09% below the session high with price essentially at the top of the intraday structure. Entering long here risks buying exhaustion at resistance with minimal upside to the high, while entering short against a strong intraday uptrend (price well above VWAP at $720.24 and above the 9-EMA at $730.88) carries momentum risk. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable at this position in the range, and with no news catalyst to anchor a directional thesis, the prudent action is to wait for a cleaner setup.
